title: DualisCapax unit forest
law: Structure first. Independent units — no timesliced one-brain. Harvest cites into packs; never invent. Platform scaffold for public-system seats — Dualis is not the government and claims no throne.

trunks.role: government-class residual seats (measure / cite / scaffold — not sovereign power)

order_law.summary: Spawn and verify in layer order. Cap at the highest layer a unit needs. Do not re-verify a verifier that is already proven.

layers.name: cite_class
layers.means: Allowed public cite sources named; never invent

layers.name: harvest_script
layers.means: Script writes real packs from cites

layers.name: workflow_cron
layers.means: Independent Actions workflow on an offset slot

layers.name: live_registry
layers.means: Listed in FOREST.live with proven lower layers

order_law.cap_rule: A unit runs verification only up to the highest layer it needs for its current status. If layer N-1 is already proven for that unit (or a shared infra verifier), do not re-prove it every tick.

cron_slots.note: Assign each live unit a unique minute offset. Avoid same-minute pileups. GH schedules often slip; gaps still reduce push races.
cron_slots.legacy_stagger_note: swarm_runner :00, swarm_bot_fleet :15, unity_mesh :30 — ledger/stub rails; golf harvest owns slot A

queued.note: Cite class locked; harvest script next — no free-run cron

anti_circle.law: Three-check before act: already tried? how failed? new method or stop.
